name: geodd
description: Manage Geodd model API access, monitor request volume, RPM and end-to-end latency, inspect GPU infrastructure, preview GPU launches, add SSH keys, and manage support tickets.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Geodd account to view your profile, available AI models, masked API keys, inference usage, and rate limits. Monitor request volume, success rates, errors, average and peak RPM, and end-to-end latency including p50 and p95. View hourly trends over the daily window or daily trends over weekly and monthly windows, across your account or for one API key. Latency percentiles summarize the selected window; trend buckets report mean latency. Inspect GPU capacity and instances, preview GPU launch costs without provisioning, list SSH keys, and add SSH keys. Browse support categories and tickets, create tickets, reply, and close tickets. Prepare inference API keys for explicit browser confirmation in Geodd DeployPad; full key secrets remain in the console and are never returned through chat. Billing changes, payments, and direct GPU provisioning are not supported.
capabilities: Create API keys through secure browser confirmation
Review inference usage and rate limits
Monitor request volume, success rates, errors, and average/peak RPM
Check p50/p95 end-to-end latency and hourly or daily request trends
Preview GPU launch costs without provisioning
List and add SSH keys to your Geodd account
Create, reply to, and close support tickets
defaultPrompt: Show the AI models available to my Geodd account.
Show available models, then help me create an API key named chatgpt-demo for the model I select.
Show my hourly request usage for the daily window, including p50/p95 end-to-end latency, average and peak RPM, and errors.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with account profiles, model and API-key visibility, browser-confirmed API-key creation, usage reads, request analytics with hourly/daily trends, RPM and end-to-end latency percentiles, GPU visibility and launch previews, SSH-key creation, and support ticket management in ChatGPT and Codex. Billing management, payments, and direct GPU provisioning are excluded.
